name: The Prancing Pony
preview: A warm, welcoming tavern known for its hearty meals and comfortable rooms...
description: The Prancing Pony stands as the heart of the town's social life. With its thick stone walls, heavy wooden beams, and roaring fireplace, it offers respite to weary travelers and locals alike. The common room buzzes with conversation, and the smell of roasted meat and fresh bread fills the air. Upstairs, clean rooms with comfortable beds await those needing rest.

name: Ironforge Armaments
preview: Master craftsman Durgan creates weapons and armor renowned throughout the realm...
description: The rhythmic pounding of hammer on anvil echoes from this renowned smithy. Durgan Ironforge, a dwarf of legendary skill, crafts weapons and armor that are both functional and beautiful. The shop displays an impressive array of swords, axes, shields, and plate armor, each piece showing the master's attention to detail and quality.

name: Mystic Curiosities
preview: A mysterious shop filled with arcane artifacts, spell components, and magical services...
description: Crystals hum with magical energy in the windows of this enigmatic establishment. Inside, shelves line the walls from floor to ceiling, filled with spell components, potions, scrolls, and minor magical items. The air shimmers with residual magic, and the scent of exotic herbs and ozone fills the space. Madame Zelara, the proprietor, offers both goods and magical services to those with coin and need.

name: The Healer's Haven
preview: A peaceful sanctuary offering healing potions, herbs, and medical treatment...
description: Bundles of dried herbs hang from the rafters, filling this cozy shop with the scent of lavender, sage, and other healing plants. Glass bottles containing colorful potions line the shelves, while a garden visible through the back window grows medicinal plants. The proprietor, Brother Marcus, tends to both the shop and the sick with equal care and devotion.

name: The Silver Saddle
preview: A roadside stable offering horses, supplies, and shelter for travelers...
description: This weathered but sturdy stable sits at the crossroads, serving travelers heading in all directions. The stalls house a variety of horses, from sturdy pack animals to swift riding mounts. The attached shop sells traveling gear, feed, and basic supplies. While not luxurious, it's clean, honest, and reliable - exactly what road-weary travelers need.

name: The Golden Goblet
preview: The finest establishment in the capital, catering to nobles and wealthy merchants...
description: Marble floors, crystal chandeliers, and silk tapestries mark this as the most prestigious inn in the capital. Each room is a suite fit for nobility, with feather beds, private baths, and personal service. The dining hall serves exotic delicacies prepared by master chefs, while the wine cellar holds vintages from across the realm. Only the wealthy can afford to stay here, but the luxury is unmatched.
